title.en: Create and manage workspaces and assets
title.zh: 创建和管理工作区与资产

takeaways.en: A workspace is where a team creates and keeps reports, semantic models, dashboards and other items.
takeaways.zh: 工作区是团队建立和存放报表、语义模型、仪表板等项目的地方。

takeaways.en: Workspace settings include name, description, contact list, licence mode (Pro, PPU, Premium or Fabric capacity) and Git integration.
takeaways.zh: 工作区设置包括名称、说明、联系人列表、授权模式（Pro、PPU、Premium 或 Fabric 容量）以及 Git 集成。

takeaways.en: Publishing from Desktop sends the report and its semantic model; republishing replaces both.
takeaways.zh: 从 Desktop 发布会同时发送报表和它的语义模型；重新发布会同时替换两者。

html.en: Every user has My workspace for personal work. Team content belongs in a shared workspace: Workspaces → New workspace. Plan one workspace per team or subject, and often separate workspaces (or a deployment pipeline) for development, test and production.
html.zh: 每个用户都有个人使用的我的工作区。团队内容应放在共享工作区：工作区 → 新建工作区。规划时按团队或主题各建一个工作区，开发、测试和正式环境通常也分开（或使用部署管道）。

rows.en: Help people find the right workspace
rows.zh: 帮助用户找到正确的工作区

rows.en: Who receives access requests and notifications
rows.zh: 谁会收到访问请求和通知

rows.en: Pro, Premium per user, Premium capacity, Fabric capacity, Embedded — decides features and who can view
rows.zh: Pro、按用户 Premium、Premium 容量、Fabric 容量、Embedded——决定功能和谁能查看
项目的版本控制（Fabric 容量）

rows.en: Allow contributors to update the app
Let the Contributor role publish app changes
rows.zh: 让「参与者」角色发布应用更新

items.en: Publish in Desktop: pick the workspace; the .pbix becomes a report plus a semantic model.
items.zh: 在 Desktop 中发布：选择工作区；.pbix 会变成一份报表加一个语义模型。

items.en: Publishing a file with the same name asks to replace the existing items; links, dashboards pinned from it and app content keep working.
items.zh: 发布同名文件时会询问是否替换现有项目；链接、从中固定的仪表板和应用内容都会继续有效。

items.en: In the service, Upload a .pbix, .xlsx or .rdl, or connect to a file in OneDrive/SharePoint so changes sync automatically.
items.zh: 在服务中可以上传 .pbix、.xlsx 或 .rdl，或连接到 OneDrive/SharePoint 中的文件，让修改自动同步。

items.en: Many reports can share one semantic model: publish it once and build "thin" reports that connect to it.
items.zh: 多份报表可以共用一个语义模型：只发布一次模型，再制作连接它的「精简」报表。

items.en: Deployment pipelines (Premium, PPU or Fabric capacity) promote content from Development to Test to Production.
items.zh: 部署管道（Premium、PPU 或 Fabric 容量）把内容从开发推进到测试，再到正式环境。

q.en: Three teams build reports on the same sales data. How do you avoid three copies of the model?
q.zh: 三个团队都基于相同的销售数据制作报表。如何避免模型有三个副本？

html.en: Publish one shared semantic model and build thin reports that connect to it
html.zh: 发布一个共享语义模型，再制作连接它的精简报表

html.en: Each team imports the data in their own .pbix
html.zh: 每个团队在自己的 .pbix 中导入数据

why.en: That creates three models to refresh and keep in sync.
why.zh: 那样就有三个模型要刷新和保持一致。

html.en: Put all reports in My workspace
html.zh: 把所有报表放在「我的工作区」

heading.en: Apps and choosing a distribution method
heading.zh: 应用与分发方式的选择

takeaways.en: An app packages a workspace's content for many viewers; changes reach them only after you update the app.
takeaways.zh: 应用把工作区的内容打包给大量读者；只有在你更新应用后，变更才会送到他们手中。

takeaways.en: Apps can have several audiences, each seeing a different set of reports.
takeaways.zh: 应用可以有多个受众，每个受众看到不同的报表组合。

takeaways.en: Other methods: workspace access, direct sharing, embedding in Teams or SharePoint, subscriptions — and Publish to web only for truly public data.
takeaways.zh: 其他方式：工作区访问权限、直接分享、嵌入 Teams 或 SharePoint、订阅——「发布到 Web」只适用于真正公开的数据。

rows.zh: 制作或共同编辑内容的人

rows.en: Gives access to everything in the workspace
rows.zh: 可访问工作区中的所有内容

rows.en: Large, read-only audiences across the organisation

rows.zh: 整理过的导航、受众、受控的更新

rows.en: Power BI permissions and RLS still apply
rows.zh: Power BI 权限和 RLS 仍然有效

rows.en: Recipients still need access to open the report
rows.zh: 收件人打开报表时仍需要访问权限

rows.en: Anyone on the internet can see it; no security. Often disabled by admins
rows.zh: 互联网上任何人都能看到；没有任何安全保护。管理员经常停用

rows.en: Reports inside your own application for customers
rows.zh: 在你自己的应用程序中向客户提供报表
需要嵌入式容量和开发工作

items.en: In the workspace choose Create app: set name, description, logo and colour; add content and sections; set navigation.
items.zh: 在工作区中选择创建应用：设定名称、说明、徽标和颜色；加入内容和分节；设定导航。

items.en: Audiences: create several audience groups and hide items per audience.
items.zh: 受众：建立多个受众组，按受众隐藏项目。

items.en: Permissions: let users build content with the app's semantic models (Build), reshare, and install the app automatically.
items.zh: 权限：允许用户使用应用的语义模型制作内容（生成）、重新分享，以及自动安装应用。

items.en: Edits in the workspace are not visible to app users until you select Update app.
items.zh: 在工作区中所做的修改，要选择更新应用之后，应用用户才看得到。

html.en: "Hundreds of read-only users, different departments see different reports, changes released together" → a workspace app with audiences.
html.zh: 「数百名只读用户、不同部门看到不同报表、变更要一起发布」→ 使用带受众的工作区应用。

q.en: You fixed a measure in a report in the workspace, but app users still see the old numbers. What is missing?
q.zh: 你在工作区中修正了报表里的一个度量值，但应用用户看到的仍是旧数字。漏了什么？

why.en: A measure change is in the model definition, not the data.
why.zh: 度量值的修改属于模型定义，而不是数据。

why.en: Right: the app shows the content as it was when last published.
why.zh: 对：应用显示的是上次发布时的内容。

q.en: A public charity wants its annual statistics on its public website, visible without signing in. Which method?
q.zh: 某公益组织想把年度统计放在公开网站上，访客不需要登录就能看。用哪种方式？

html.en: Publish to web (if allowed by the admin, and only because the data is public)
html.zh: 发布到 Web（需管理员允许，而且只因为数据是公开的）

heading.zh: 仪表板、订阅与数据警报

takeaways.en: Dashboards are built in the service by pinning visuals or whole live pages from reports, possibly several reports.
takeaways.zh: 仪表板在服务中建立，方法是从报表（可来自多份报表）固定视觉对象或整个实时页面。

takeaways.en: Data alerts can be set only on dashboard tiles of type card, KPI and gauge.
takeaways.zh: 数据警报只能设定在卡片、KPI 和仪表类型的仪表板磁贴上。

takeaways.en: Subscriptions email a snapshot of a report page or dashboard on a schedule to you or others.
takeaways.zh: 订阅会按计划把报表页或仪表板的快照通过邮件发给你或其他人。

items.en: Open a report in the service, hover a visual and select Pin visual; choose a new or existing dashboard.
items.zh: 在服务中打开报表，悬停在视觉对象上选择固定视觉对象；选择新的或现有的仪表板。

items.en: Pin to a dashboard → live page pins a whole report page that stays interactive.
items.zh: 固定到仪表板 → 实时页面会固定整个报表页，并保持可交互。

items.en: A tile opens the report it came from; tiles from different reports and models can sit on one dashboard.
items.zh: 点击磁贴会打开其来源报表；来自不同报表和模型的磁贴可以放在同一个仪表板上。

items.en: Dashboards have their own theme, mobile view and Q&A box (where enabled).
items.zh: 仪表板有自己的主题、移动视图和问答框（若已启用）。

rows.zh: 多份报表 / 多个模型

rows.en: No (tiles are fixed; live pages keep their slicers)
rows.zh: 没有（磁贴是固定的；实时页面保留其切片器）

rows.en: Yes, on card, KPI and gauge tiles
rows.zh: 有，在卡片、KPI 和仪表磁贴上

items.en: Subscribe on a report or dashboard: choose recipients, frequency (daily, weekly, after data refresh), and the page; recipients need access.
items.zh: 在报表或仪表板上订阅：选择收件人、频率（每天、每周、数据刷新后）和页面；收件人需要有访问权限。

items.en: Data alert on a tile: "notify me when Total Sales is above 1,000,000"; at most once an hour or once a day; delivered to the notification centre and email, and can trigger Power Automate.
items.zh: 磁贴上的数据警报：「当 Total Sales 高于 1,000,000 时通知我」；最多每小时一次或每天一次；发送到通知中心和邮件，也可以触发 Power Automate。

items.en: Alerts work only for data that refreshes; they are personal to the user who sets them.
items.zh: 警报只适用于会刷新的数据；只对设定它的用户本人有效。

q.en: A manager wants an email when daily returns exceed 500. The value is shown in a card on a report. What must happen first?
q.zh: 某经理希望每日退货超过 500 时收到邮件。这个值显示在报表的一张卡片中。首先要做什么？

why.en: A subscription sends on a schedule, not on a threshold.
why.zh: 订阅按计划发送，而不是按阈值发送。

html.en: Pin the card to a dashboard, then set a data alert on the tile
html.zh: 把卡片固定到仪表板，再在磁贴上设定数据警报

why.en: Right: data alerts exist on dashboard tiles (card, KPI, gauge).
why.zh: 对：数据警报只存在于仪表板磁贴上（卡片、KPI、仪表）。

html.en: Set the alert on the report visual
html.zh: 在报表视觉对象上设定警报

why.en: Report visuals do not support data alerts.
why.zh: 报表视觉对象不支持数据警报。

takeaways.en: Endorsement labels help people find trustworthy content: Promoted, Certified and (for data) Master data.
takeaways.zh: 认可标签帮助大家找到值得信赖的内容：已提升、已认证，以及（针对数据的）主数据。

takeaways.en: Anyone with write permission on an item can Promote it; only reviewers authorised by the admin can Certify it.
takeaways.zh: 任何对项目有写入权限的人都可以「提升」它；只有管理员授权的审阅者才能「认证」它。

takeaways.en: Endorsed semantic models appear first when report authors search for data.
takeaways.zh: 已认可的语义模型会在报表作者搜索数据时优先显示。

rows.en: Item owners / anyone with write permission
rows.zh: 项目所有者 / 任何有写入权限的人

rows.en: "We think this is ready to share and reuse."
rows.zh: 「我们认为这已经可以分享和重用。」

rows.en: Reviewers named by the Power BI/Fabric admin
rows.zh: 由 Power BI/Fabric 管理员指定的审阅者

rows.en: Meets the organisation's quality standards; authoritative
rows.zh: 符合组织的质量标准；具有权威性

rows.en: Core reference data (customers, products) — the single source of truth
rows.zh: 核心参考数据（客户、产品）——单一事实来源

html.en: Set it in the item's Settings → Endorsement. Endorsement is about trust and discovery; it does not change who can access the item.
html.zh: 在项目的设置 → 认可中设定。认可关乎信任和可发现性；它不会改变谁能访问该项目。

q.en: You built a semantic model and want report authors to see that the finance team stands behind it, but the certification process is not available to you. What can you do?
q.zh: 你建立了一个语义模型，想让报表作者知道财务团队为它背书，但你无法使用认证流程。可以怎么做？

why.en: Labels are about protection, not quality.
why.zh: 标签关乎保护，不关乎质量。

why.en: Right: promotion is open to item owners; certification needs authorised reviewers.
why.zh: 对：项目所有者就能提升；认证需要授权的审阅者。
只有授权的审阅者才能认证。

takeaways.en: A gateway is needed when the service must reach data it cannot see from the cloud: on-premises servers and local files.
takeaways.zh: 当服务需要访问从云端看不到的数据时，就需要网关：本地服务器和本机文件。

takeaways.en: Standard mode serves many users and supports DirectQuery; personal mode is for one user, Import only.
takeaways.zh: 标准模式供多人使用并支持 DirectQuery；个人模式只供一人使用，且只支持导入。

takeaways.en: Scheduled refresh: up to 8 times a day with Pro, up to 48 with Premium, PPU or Fabric capacity.
takeaways.zh: 计划刷新：Pro 每天最多 8 次，Premium、PPU 或 Fabric 容量每天最多 48 次。

rows.en: SQL Server on a company server
rows.zh: 公司服务器上的 SQL Server

rows.en: Excel file on C:\ or a network share
rows.zh: C:\ 或网络共享上的 Excel 文件
Azure SQL 数据库、Fabric 湖仓

rows.en: Excel file in SharePoint Online / OneDrive (by URL)
rows.zh: SharePoint Online / OneDrive 中的 Excel 文件（用网址）

rows.en: Data in an Azure virtual network
rows.zh: Azure 虚拟网络中的数据

rows.en: A VNet data gateway (or standard gateway)
rows.zh: 虚拟网络数据网关（或标准网关）

rows.en: Only the person who installed it
A Windows service, ideally on an always-on server
rows.zh: Windows 服务，最好装在常开的服务器上

rows.en: An app on the user's computer
rows.zh: 用户电脑上的应用程序

items.en: In the semantic model's Settings, map it to a gateway connection (if needed) and enter data source credentials.
items.zh: 在语义模型的设置中，把它对应到网关连接（如果需要），并输入数据源凭据。

items.en: Turn on Scheduled refresh, choose frequency, time zone and times (up to 8/day with Pro, 48/day with Premium/PPU/Fabric capacity).
items.zh: 开启计划刷新，选择频率、时区和时间（Pro 每天最多 8 次，Premium/PPU/Fabric 容量每天最多 48 次）。

items.en: Set failure notifications to the owner and other contacts.
items.zh: 设定失败通知，发送给所有者和其他联系人。

items.en: For big tables, configure incremental refresh so only recent partitions reload.
items.zh: 对于大表，配置增量刷新，只重新加载最近的分区。

html.en: DirectQuery and live connection models do not need scheduled data refresh — queries go to the source — but the service can refresh visual caches. Very large models on capacity can use the large semantic model storage format.
html.zh: DirectQuery 和实时连接模型不需要计划刷新数据——查询直接发往数据源——但服务可以刷新视觉对象缓存。容量上的超大模型可以使用大型语义模型存储格式。

q.en: A report imports from an on-premises SQL Server and an Azure SQL Database. Which needs a gateway?
q.zh: 某报表从本地 SQL Server 和 Azure SQL 数据库导入数据。哪个需要网关？

why.en: Cloud sources are reached directly by the service.
why.zh: 服务可以直接访问云端数据源。

html.zh: 只有 Azure SQL 数据库

q.en: Several analysts publish reports using the same on-premises Oracle database, some in DirectQuery. Which gateway setup?
q.zh: 多位分析师发布的报表都使用同一个本地 Oracle 数据库，其中一些用 DirectQuery。应采用哪种网关设置？

why.en: The data is on-premises, not in an Azure virtual network.
why.zh: 数据在本地，不在 Azure 虚拟网络中。

html.en: An on-premises data gateway in standard mode, shared through gateway connections
html.zh: 标准模式的本地数据网关，通过网关连接共享

html.en: A personal-mode gateway on each analyst's laptop
html.zh: 在每位分析师的笔记本电脑上装个人模式网关

why.en: Personal mode does not support DirectQuery or sharing.
why.zh: 个人模式不支持 DirectQuery，也不能共享。

q.en: With Pro licences, what is the maximum number of scheduled refreshes per day for one semantic model?
q.zh: 使用 Pro 授权时，一个语义模型每天最多可以计划刷新几次？

why.en: 48 is the limit on Premium, PPU or Fabric capacity.
why.zh: 48 次是 Premium、PPU 或 Fabric 容量的上限。
